verdict.rationale: Rive documents RML (a text-based/XML representation of Rive files) and open-source runtimes that can load/parse .riv files (rive-docs-13/20/25/30, rive-gh-1/3), suggesting some portability outside the editor. However, community evidence directly disputes this: the open-source runtime is described as only a rendering/playback layer, and actually authoring or building Rive content still requires the proprietary, paid Rive Editor (rive-comm-5), undercutting claims of full format openness/portability. Missing for 10: a public, versioned .riv binary spec independent of RML, third-party tools that can author/edit .riv files without the vendor's editor, and confirmation that RML round-trips losslessly with the binary format.
